mechanism: Recursion applies computational models, biological data, and automated experimentation to identify and advance drug candidates; repeatable gains in target selection, cycle time, or clinical translation can create pipeline and partner value, but common-share benefit depends on trial success, partner economics, operating burn, capital needs, and dilution.
catalyst: Blinded clinical data support efficacy and safety, FDA engagement produces clear development paths, REC-4881 and REC-1245 advance, partner milestones become repeatable, measured discovery-cycle or probability-of-success improvements are disclosed, and operating burn declines without financing that overwhelms per-share value.
invalidation: Programs fail safety or efficacy tests; development time or cost does not improve; candidates are repeatedly deprioritized; partnership revenue remains immaterial; proprietary-data commitments consume capital without measurable output; or financing and dilution absorb the platform value attributable to existing common shares.
